assessments.reasoning: Microsoft’s pinned ROWCOUNT remarks establish that the setting takes effect at execution and that zero disables its row limit. This supplies the execution condition under which the companion TOP reference determines the selected rows. ROWCOUNT supplies no ordering rule.

Microsoft’s TOP reference assigns selection priority to the ORDER BY of the SELECT using TOP. Its SQL Server syntax permits an integer count with PERCENT and WITH TIES omitted. Given at least n eligible rows and a unique ordering, the ordered prefix has exactly n identifiable rows. The ROWCOUNT reference at the same revision establishes that effective zero imposes no competing limit.

limitations: The proposition is documentary and scoped to the pinned SQL Server references. It excludes nonzero ROWCOUNT, ties in the specified ordering, ordering on an enclosing set operation, and Azure or Fabric behavior.
